City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MAY 14, 2019
06:30
P.M.
5-14-19 Agenda
6:30 P.M. CLOSED SESSION
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Munoz, Klinakis, Holloway, Lewis and Solis

PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of LEAD Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Presentation by LA County Department of Public Works Regarding the Puente Creek Bikeways Plan
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF APRIL 17, 2019 (2 SETS), AND APRIL 23, 2019
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of April 17, 2019 (2 sets), and April 23, 2019.
A-1 Minutes 4-17-19 CC SA Legislative Meeting
A-1 Minutes 4-17-19 CC SA Park Master Plan
A-1 Minutes 4-23-19 CC SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 99-4025 AND ADOPTING THE SCHEDULE OF RATES, FEES, AND OTHER CHARGES FOR SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE CITY FOR BUSINESS AND OCCUPATION PERMITS
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 19-5486 approving the schedule of rates, fees and other charges for services provided by the City for business and occupation permits.
B-1 Amended Business Occupation Permits Fee Staff Report
B-1 Amended Business Occupation Permits Fee Attachment A Resolution
B-1 Amended Business Occupation Permits Fee Attachment B Comparison
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL – None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1470
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 19-5487 approving Warrant Register No. 1470.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1470
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER FOR SERVANTS ARMS COMMUNITY BASED ORGANIZATION FOR A COMMUNITY BLOCK PARTY AT LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER/YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER AND LA PUENTE PARK IN THE AMOUNT OF $4,013.60
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5488 approving a request for a fee waiver for Servants Arms Community Based Organization for a community block party in the amount of $4.013.60.
D-2 Servants Arms Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-2 Servants Arms Fee Waiver Attachment A Resolution
D-2 Servants Arms Fee Waiver Attachment B Request
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A COMMUNITY SERVICES AGREEMENT BETWEEN JASMINE REAL ESTATE INVESTMENTS LLC, THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE FORMER COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, AND THE CITY OF LA PUENTE FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT THE CORNER OF HACIENDA BOULEVARD AND FAIRGROVE AVENUE FOR A MEDICAL USE
It is recommended that the Successor Agency and City Council: (1) approve the Community Services Agreement with Jasmine Real Estate Investments LLC; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-3 Jasmine Community Service Agreement Staff Report
D-3 Jasmine Community Service Agreement Attachment A Agreement
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A LIABILITY AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR THE COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE COLLECTION EVENT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Countywide Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program Siting Liability Agreement; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
D-4 Household Hazardous Waste Event Staff Report
D-4 Household Hazardous Waste Event Attachment A Agreement
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF A PURCHASE ORDER CONTRACT WITH ED BUTTS FORD FOR PURCHASE OF TWO NEW 2019 FORD SPECIAL SERVICE PLUG-IN HYBRID FWD SEDANS IN THE AMOUNT OF $75,516.82
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the purchase order contract with Ed Butts Ford for purchase of two new 2019 Ford Special Service Plug-In Hybrid FWD Sedans; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute, on behalf of the City, all documents necessary to effectuate this action.
D-5 Ford Special Service Vehicle Purchase Staff Report
D-5 Ford Special Service Vehicle Purchase Attachment A RFB
D-5 Ford Special Service Vehicle Purchase Attachment B Bid Sheet
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF REJECTION OF ALL BIDS FOR THE AMAR ROAD AND ELLIOTT AVENUE RIGHT-OF-WAY IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT AND AUTHORIZATION TO RE-ADVERTISE AND SOLICIT BIDS FOR THE PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) reject all bids received for the Amar Road and Elliot Avenue Parkway Landscape Improvement Project; (2) approve revised specifications; and (3) authorize Staff to re-advertise and solicit bids for Project.
D-6 Reject Bids Amar Elliott ROW Staff Report
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF: (1) AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH AMERINATIONAL COMMUNITY SERVICES, LLC, FOR LOAN SERVICING AND ESCROW SERVICES; AND (2) AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH FARMERS STATE BANK OF HARTLAND FOR FUND DISBURSEMENT SERVICES FOR THE CITY’S CAL-HOME HOUSING REHABILITATION LOAN PROGRAM EXTENDING THE TERM OF EACH AGREEMENT FOR AN ADDITIONAL YEAR
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 2 with AmeriNational Community Services, Inc. for loan servicing and escrow services and Amendment No. 2 with Farmers State Bank of Hartland, MN for fund disbursement services extending the term of each agreement for an additional year; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the amendments on behalf of the City.
D-7 AmeriNat and Farmers Bank Amend 2 Staff Report
D-7 AmeriNat and Farmers Bank Amend 2 Attachment A AmeriNat
D-7 AmeriNat and Farmers Bank Amend 2 Attachment B Farmers
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING ADMINISTRATIVE POLICY #55, PART-TIME EMPLOYEE TERMS, CONDITIONS AND BENEFITS POLICY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5489 adopting a new Administrative Policy #55 establishing the City’s Part-Time Employee Terms, Conditions and Benefits Policy.
D-8 Admin Policy #55 Part Time Benefits Staff Report
D-8 Admin Policy #55 Part Time Benefits Attachment A Resolution
D-9
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING THE CODE ENFORCEMENT JOB DESCRIPTION TO ADD ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS, CHARACTERISTICS AND QUALIFICATIONS FOR ANIMAL CONTROL RELATED ENFORCEMENT AND SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council approve the amended Code Enforcement job description to include animal control related enforcement and services.
D-9 Amended Code Enforcement Job Description Staff Report
D-9 Amended Code Enforcement Job Description Attachment A Description
D-10
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT TO DOUG MARTIN CONTRACTING CO., INC. FOR THE CITYWIDE SLURRY SEAL STREET PROJECT IN THE AMOUNT OF $241,009.70
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to Doug Martin Contracting Co., Inc. in the amount of $241,009.70; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement and approve change orders up to 15% of the original bid amount.
D-10 Doug Martin Slurry Seal Award Staff Report
D-10 Doug Martin Slurry Seal Award Attachment A Agreement
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PRESENTATION AND UPDATE ON THE CITY’S PLAN TO PREVENT AND COMBAT HOMELESSNESS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the presentation.
E-1 Homeless Plan Update Staff Report
E-1 Homeless Plan Update Attachment A Plan
E-1 Homeless Plan Update Attachment B Homeless Resources List
E-1 Homeless Plan Update Attachment C HOP Information Sheet
E-2
INTRODUCTION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, CALIFORNIA, REPEALING CHAPTER 3.36 OF TITLE 3 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE IN ITS ENTIRETY AND ADOPTING A REVISED CHAPTER 3.36 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE - ANIMAL CONTROL ORDINANCE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) waive reading of Ordinance No. 19-961 and read by title only; and (2) introduce Ordinance No. 19-961, an ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente, Repealing Chapter 3.36 of Title 3 of the La Puente Municipal Code in its Entirety and Adopting a Revised Chapter 3.36 of the La Puente Municipal Code - Animal Control Ordinance.
E-2 Animal Control Ordinance Staff Report
E-2 Animal Control Ordinance Attachment A Ordinance
E-2 Animal Control Ordinance Attachment B Fee Resolution
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
